title: Keep target-scale Git object writes practical
description: 10,000-task benchmark exposed rebuild taking more than one minute due to one Git process per blob. Benchmark case exists before optimization.
acceptance: 10,000 total, 1,000 active and 100 ready tasks preserve correct views and canonical bytes.
Record baseline and post-change timings; source isolation, CAS race and sync tests still pass.

notes.body: 10,000 tasks / 1,000 active / 100 ready: old rebuild exceeded 133s and was stopped; final installed aye ready 0.900s, rebuild 2.399s, update 2.191s. Batched blob and tree construction retains ref CAS/source isolation.
